_doc: Answer key for the 'shop' benchmark fixture. `base/` is committed on main; `change/` is overlaid and committed on a feature branch. `prr score` counts a seeded bug as FOUND when a verified (postable) finding sits in the same file within `tolerance` lines of the range AND its title+body matches `match` (case-insensitive regex). A verified finding on a bait is a false positive. Verified findings that match nothing are listed as 'extra' for a human to judge (they may be legitimate).
